offering_description.value: Supplies new and used aircraft parts to airlines, maintenance providers and government fleets. It maintains aircraft and repairs components at its own facilities and manages parts inventories and logistics under fleet support contracts. It also sells aircraft maintenance software and makes cargo handling and deployable equipment for government customers.

primary_products.value: Aircraft and engine parts; avionics and electronic components; aircraft maintenance software; air cargo pallets and containers; deployable shelters

primary_services.value: Airframe maintenance and modifications; component repair and overhaul; fleet logistics and inventory management; aviation engineering; government aviation support

customer_segment.value: B2B: Passenger and cargo airlines, aircraft maintenance providers and aerospace manufacturers; B2G: Military services and government aviation agencies

end_markets.value: Commercial passenger aviation; air cargo; aerospace manufacturing; military aviation; government logistics

revenue_model.value: product sales: New and used aircraft parts, electronic components and military deployment equipment; service fees: Airframe maintenance, component overhaul and engineering work; project or contract: Multiyear fleet support, inventory management and government aviation contracts; transaction or usage fees: Parts and component support billed by flight hour; licensing or royalties: Aircraft maintenance and fleet management software licenses; subscription: Cloud-hosted aircraft maintenance software
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; project or contract; transaction or usage fees; licensing or royalties; subscription

value_chain_position.value: distributor: Sources new and used aviation parts for airlines, repair shops and government fleets; service provider: Maintains aircraft, overhauls components and manages parts inventories for commercial and government fleet operators; software / platform: Turns maintenance and inventory records into planning and compliance tools for airlines and repair shops; OEM / manufacturer: Fabricates cargo pallets, containers and deployable shelters for military and government customers
value_chain_position.category: distributor; service provider; software / platform; OEM / manufacturer

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and the Middle East

specialization.value: related lines: Aircraft parts distribution, maintenance and overhaul, fleet support, maintenance software and military mobility equipment

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Airline and repair-shop accounts, fleet support agreements and government procurement contracts; own locations: Company-operated airframe maintenance hangars and component repair shops; online: Online aircraft parts ordering and cloud delivery of maintenance software

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Aircraft and component repairs require aviation authority approvals, including FAA and EASA certifications. Defense work carries export controls.

notes: The current scope of the military mobility equipment line is uncertain.
